subject: executor: fix data race in hash join v2 spill (#57519)
summary: This commit moves per-worker `rowTableBuilder` initialization out of the concurrent BuildWorker split routines into `HashJoinV2Exec.fetchAndBuildHashTableImpl`, ensuring spill code (`hashJoinSpillHelper.spillRowTableImpl`) can read `worker.builder`/`builder.rowNumberInCurrentRowTableSeg` without racing with builder assignment. Review of the surrounding build/restore and spill synchronization shows the builder is initialized before any spill can trigger and is not reassigned during the build stage. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, or concurrency issues found; later upstream history contains additional hash join changes but no follow-up fix suggesting a regression from this change.
